about.intro: Seven years shipping full-stack applications to production — from AI chat platforms and crypto exchanges to Web3 prediction markets and food-tech. I've built AI agentic platforms, led engineering teams, and written Solidity contracts that settle real money on-chain.
paragraphs: I specialize in building full-stack applications with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Node.js. My work spans AI-integrated products (LiteLLM, RAG), Web3 DApps (Solidity on Polygon), crypto exchanges, real estate platforms, and food-tech systems.

I built the platform for aim2balance.ai — an EU-hosted AI chat system operated under Bergwaldprojekt eV. Each session's energy and water draw is measured and converted to funded m² of reforestation — the cost hits the billing pipeline, not a carbon ledger. It runs a LiteLLM proxy for model routing and per-session cost capture, EUR-based billing with auto-recharge Stripe wallets, and a Chrome extension tracking token consumption across ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. Before that, I led a 3-person team building three products simultaneously at Zoof-it.
Currently based in Greece, available for freelance projects and consulting engagements.
